DISCLAIMER:
**Please be kind NOT TO Redistribute anything from this sample list.
**Contains some Sound Canvas, Arachno, FluidR3, SGM, Musyng, OmegaGMGS2 and Orpheus Samples...
**Make sure that you have ENABLED any sort of operation to "USE BANK 127 FOR DRUM KITS IN XG MODE" (Probably VirtualMIDISynth..)
This soundfont will nearly support Yamaha XG Drum mapping configuration. But may not all the GS/XG Voices (Instruments). Besides of Roland GS SFX and some few special new additions by me.
**As it turned out while using Yamaha S-YXG50 VSTi, Yamaha XG Soundset is more used to access various instruments by CC#32 (Bank Select LSB) messages rather than traditional CC#0 (MSB) messages used in GS.
SF2 format does not support that. It is only functional in Most significant level only. So the hardwork goes on and on starting from repatching the old 90's Yamaha MusicSoft MIDI files.
